question: What power over the triple world comes from contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored object is to be contemplated always
The triple world is named as object
The result is the ability to shake it
inference: Constant contemplation of a smoke-colored form enables one to shake the triple world
uncertainties: The exact object that is smoke-colored is implied rather than explicitly named
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
